Product Description

A2F Series Axial Piston Pumps A2F55W2Z2 A2F107L2Z3 A2F107W2P2

 

Description

- Bent - axis axial piston components with fixed displacement. Used as pumps or motors in open/closed hydrostatic transmission circuits.

- As a pump, flow is proportional to drive speed and displacement.

- As a motor, output speed is proportional to flow and inversely to displacement. Output torque rises with pressure difference.

- High - performance rotating assembly with spherical valve plate: self - centering, low speed, high efficiency.

- Durable bearings for long life. Drive shaft can take radial loads.

- ISO mounting flanges (from size 55, consistent for fixed - and variable - displacement). Compatible with fire - resistant fluid.

- Low noise.

description_en:
Product Description

Piston Pump Axial Piston Fixed Motor A2F Series 

 

Features

This product has a fixed displacement, applicable as a pump or motor for hydrostatic transmission in both open and closed systems.

 

- As a Pump: Flow rate is directly proportional to rotational speed and displacement.

- As a Motor: Output rotational speed is directly related to input and inversely related to displacement. Output torque grows with the increase of pressure difference between high and low pressure sides.

 

Structural & Performance Advantages

- Load - bearing Capacity: The drive shaft can bear radial loads.

- Efficient Oil Distribution: The cylinder block and valve plate use spherical oil distribution, enabling automatic alignment during rotation, with low circumferential speed and high efficiency.

- Low Noise: Operates with low noise levels.

 

Application

It has an inclined shaft structure, suitable for hydrostatic transmission in open or closed systems.

name_en: DSG-03 Series High Pressure Solenoid Directional Control Valve Terminal Box Type
description_en:
Product Description

DSG-03 Series Solenoid Operated Directional Valves Terminal Box Type

 

Features

These are epoch-making solenoid operated directional valves of high pressure, high flow which have been developed incorporating a unique design concept into every part of the valve including the solenoid. With wet type solenoids, these valves ensure the low noise and the long life, moreover, ensure no leakage of oil outside of the valve.

 

Stable Operation

With a strong magnet and spring force, the valves are tough against contamination and thus ensure a stable operation.

 

Solenoids

 

Solenoid Connectors (DIN Connector)

The solenoid connectors are conform to the international standard ISO 4400 (Fluid power systems and components-Three-pin electrical plug connectors Characteristics and requirements)

 

AC Solenoids

50 to 60 Hz common service solenoids do not require rewiring when the applied frequency is changed.

 

DC Solenoids (Reputable K-series)

These DC solenoids have surge absorbers for K-series functions. The three advantages of them are as mentioned below:

  • Since surge voltage can be controlled to a very low figure, electric control devices, such as a computer, can be used without any interference like noise.
  • There being no spark between contacts, the life of the relay becomes longer.
  • Time lag for spool return after de-energisation of the solenoid is very short.

Product Description

DSG-01 Solenoid Operated Directional Valve for Industrial Machinery High Performance


Features

Our next-generation Solenoid Operated Directional Valves deliver exceptional performance in high-pressure, high-flow applications while maintaining an ultra-low pressure drop. This leap in performance is made possible by a high-powered wet-type solenoid and an optimized 5-chamber flow path design.

 

Superior Pressure & Flow Handling

Significantly outperforms previous generations, offering both higher operating pressure and greater flow capacity.

 

Minimized Pressure Drop

Engineered for less pressure loss, directly contributing to lower energy consumption for your entire system.

 

Compact & Lightweight

Despite its high performance, the valve body remains compact and lightweight, especially in the DC double solenoid configuration.

 

Shockless Operation Option

In addition to the standard high-performance valves, a shockless variant is available to greatly reduce noise and vibration during spool shifts.

 

Exceptional Operational Stability

The robust magnetic force and strong spring ensure reliable and stable operation, even in the presence of minor contaminants.

description_en:
Product Description

Solenoid Operated Directional Valves Control Valve DSG-03 Series Plug-in Type

 

Features

These are epoch-making solenoid operated directional valves of high pressure, high flow which have been developed incorporating a unique design concept into every part of the valve including the solenoid. With wet type solenoids, these valves ensure the low noise and the long life, moreover, ensure no leakage of oil outside of the valve.

 

Stable Operation

With a strong magnet and spring force, the valves are tough against contamination and thus ensure a stable operation.

 

Solenoids

 

Solenoid Connectors (DIN Connector)

The solenoid connectors are conform to the international standard ISO 4400 (Fluid power systems and components-Three-pin electrical plug connectors Characteristics and requirements)

 

AC Solenoids

50 to 60 Hz common service solenoids do not require rewiring when the applied frequency is changed.

 

DC Solenoids (Reputable K-series)

These DC solenoids have surge absorbers for K-series functions. The three advantages of them are as mentioned below:

  • Since surge voltage can be controlled to a very low figure, electric control devices, such as a computer, can be used without any interference like noise.
  • There being no spark between contacts, the life of the relay becomes longer.
  • Time lag for spool return after de-energisation of the solenoid is very short.

description_en:
Product Description

Solenoid Controlled Pilot Operated Directional Valves High Pressure DSHG-10 Series

 

Features

These are epoch-making solenoid operated directional valves of high pressure, high flow which have been developed incorporating a unique design concept into every part of the valve including the solenoid. With wet type solenoids, these valves ensure the low noise and the long life, moreover, ensure no leakage of oil outside of the valve.

 

Stable Operation

With a strong magnet and spring force, the valves are tough against contamination and thus ensure a stable operation.

 

Solenoids

 

Solenoid Connectors (DIN connector)

The solenoid connectors are conform to the international standard ISO 4400 (Fluid power systems and components-Three-pin electrical plug connectors Characteristics and requirements)

 

AC Solenoids

50 to 60 Hz common service solenoids do not require rewiring when the applied frequency is changed.

 

DC Solenoids (Reputable K-series)

These DC solenoids have surge absorbers for K-series functions. The three advantages of them are as mentioned below:

  • Since surge voltage can be controlled to a very low figure, electric control devices, such as a computer, can be used without any interference like noise.
  • There being no spark between contacts, the life of the relay becomes longer.
  • Time lag for spool return after de-energisation of the solenoid is very short.

Features

l   Axial & radial pressure compensation design

Precautions for Use

1.Working medium

Petroleum-based mineral oil with a viscosity range of 10-300mm/s can be used. ISO VG46 anti-wear hydraulic oil is recommended.

 

2.Working temperature

The working temperature range is -10℃-100℃. In order to ensure long-term reliable life, the best working temperature range is 20℃-80℃.

 

3.Cleanliness control

The cleanliness level of the control system oil is required to be no more than 9 (NAS 1638) or 17/14 (ISO 4066).

 

4. Pump installation

When connecting the shaft and the motor, use a flexible coupling as much as possible to avoid bending moment or axial thrust. The maximum allowable coaxiality error between the shaft and the motor shaft is less than0.15mm.

 

5. Inlet pressure and piping

Allow the absolute pressure ofthe suction port to be 0.2-2Bar. The reasonable piping diameter should not be smaller than the oil suction port of the pump to ensure an average oil suction speed of 0.6-1.2m/s.

 

6. Import and export connection

Try to avoid hard connection of steel pipes in and out of the oil pipes. Rubber hoses are recommended to avoid additional noise caused by additional loads.

 

7.Exhaust

Before the first operation, the pump should be filled with oil or an exhaust valve should be added to remove the air in the pump and the system pipeline. If there is air residue in the pump or pipelinelt will cause the vibration and noise of the pump, and indirectly affect the service life of the pump.

 

8. Maintenance

In order to improve the service life of the pump, the system should be regularly checked for abnormal vibration, noise, oil temperature, whether there is bubble formation in the oil tank, and whether there is leakage and other problems, and timely maintenance.

Petroleum-based mineral oil with a viscosity range of 10-300mm/s can be used. ISO VG46 anti-wear hydraulic oil is recommended.

 

2.Working temperature

The working temperature range is -10℃-100℃. In order to ensure long-term reliable life, the best working temperature range is 20℃-80℃.

 

3.Cleanliness control

The cleanliness level of the control system oil is required to be no more than 9 (NAS 1638) or 17/14 (ISO 4066).

 

4. Pump installation

When connecting the shaft and the motor, use a flexible coupling as much as possible to avoid bending moment or axial thrust. The maximum allowable coaxiality error between the shaft and the motor shaft is less than0.15mm.

 

5. Inlet pressure and piping

Allow the absolute pressure ofthe suction port to be 0.2-2Bar. The reasonable piping diameter should not be smaller than the oil suction port of the pump to ensure an average oil suction speed of 0.6-1.2m/s.

 

6. Import and export connection

Try to avoid hard connection of steel pipes in and out of the oil pipes. Rubber hoses are recommended to avoid additional noise caused by additional loads.

 

7.Exhaust

Before the first operation, the pump should be filled with oil or an exhaust valve should be added to remove the air in the pump and the system pipeline. If there is air residue in the pump or pipelinelt will cause the vibration and noise of the pump, and indirectly affect the service life of the pump.

 

8. Maintenance

In order to improve the service life of the pump, the system should be regularly checked for abnormal vibration, noise, oil temperature, whether there is bubble formation in the oil tank, and whether there is leakage and other problems, and timely maintenance.

description_en:
Product Description

04 Series BT-04-H-32 Pilot Operated Relief Valves


Features

l   These relief control valves are commonly found in basic hydraulic systems, where they help keep pressure levels consistent.

l   Pilot-operated relief valves feature a straightforward design and offer great value.

l   The vent circuit allows for remote control and system unloading.

l   They’re engineered to shield hydraulic systems from excessive pressure.

l   A cast iron body delivers strength and durability, ensuring a longer service life.

l   Hardened steel internal parts also contribute to extended longevity.


Model Number Designation

B: Pilot Operated Relief Valve T: Tubular Mounting 04: 16 Nominal Diameter (1/2)

Precautions for Use

l   The back pressure at the oil return port must not exceed 0.5 MPa.

l   The oil return pipe should directly return to the oil tank and must not be connected to the oil return pipes of other valves.

l   When adjusting the pressure regulating handle, turn clockwise to increase the pressure and counterclockwise to decrease it. Be sure to tighten the fixing nut after pressure adjustment.

l   When the flow rate is small, the set pressure is prone to instability. For specifications 04 and 06, use a flow rate of more than 8 L/min; for specification 10, use a flow rate of more than 15 L/min.

description_en:
Product Description

KC Series Flow Control Valve KC-02 K-C03 KC-04 KC-06 KC-08

 

Features

KC type flow control valve is a kind of multifunctional valve which uses high precision pilot mode to control flow. In the pipeline used to control the flow and pressure, the predetermined flow rate is kept unchanged, the excessive flow rate is limited to a predetermined value, and the upstream high pressure is properly reduced.

 

Even if the pressure upstream of the main valve changes, the flow rate downstream of the main valve will not be affected.

 

The valve has high control sensitivity, safety and reliability, simple debugging and long service life.

description_en:
Product Description

Hydraulic Power Pack Hydraulic Power Unit for Wing Vehicle

 

Features

1. These are compact-sized and lightweight power packages that use minimal oil delivered from a small tank.

2. They come with a high-performance gear pump installed.

3. Since a manifold block can be installed directly on the hydraulic pump as an option, it is easy to configure the hydraulic circuit of the user's choice by installing a small stack valve.

4. Full return line filter is standard equipment which enables longer system life.

5. Variety of options are available,including temperature gauge,magnet,level switch,manifold block,etc.

Operation and Maintenance Guidelines

 

Air Bleed

-During initial system startup (and startups after long period of storage), pump may have difficulty drawing fluid. By pre-installing an air bleed valve (ABT-03) or by loosing a fitting in the delivery pipe, air can be bled from the system.

-During air bleed of pump and piping, pump should be run at no load.

 

Warm Up

During startup, if viscosity is higher than proper viscosity (54 mm 2 /s), system should be warmed up with pressure less than half of maximum working pressure until viscosity falls below 54 mm 2 /s.

 

Hydraulic Fluids

-Maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds,etc. Specifications may differ according to the hydraulic fluid used.

 

Mineral Oils

-Please use general industrial use anti-wear fluids.

 

Fire Resistant Fluids

-Water glycols may be used with us standard type pumps. However maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds, etc., specifications will differ from those of mineral oil fluids. Please refer to specifications of each pump for details.

-Fluorine seals are used with pumps that operate on phosphate ester fluids. An "F3-" suffix is used to designate such pumps. However specifications for maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds, etc., will differ from those of mineral oil fluids.

 

Hydraulic Fluid Viscosity and Temperature

-Please operate pump with viscosity level within 13~54 mm 2 /s range. Maximum viscosity allowed is 860 mm2/s (220 mm 2 /s for V20, V30 Series), but warm up and operation should be done in accordance with the paragraph on "Warm Up".

-Fluid temperature should be maintained below 65°C.

description_en:
Product Description

Hydraulic Power Unit for Automobile Wing Vehicle

 

Features

1. These are compact-sized and lightweight power packages that use minimal oil delivered from a small tank.

2. They come with a high-performance gear pump installed.

3. Since a manifold block can be installed directly on the hydraulic pump as an option, it is easy to configure the hydraulic circuit of the user's choice by installing a small stack valve.

4. Full return line filter is standard equipment which enables longer system life.

5. Variety of options are available,including temperature gauge,magnet,level switch,manifold block,etc.

Operation and Maintenance Guidelines

 

Air Bleed

-During initial system startup (and startups after long period of storage), pump may have difficulty drawing fluid. By pre-installing an air bleed valve (ABT-03) or by loosing a fitting in the delivery pipe, air can be bled from the system.

-During air bleed of pump and piping, pump should be run at no load.

 

Warm Up

During startup, if viscosity is higher than proper viscosity (54 mm 2 /s), system should be warmed up with pressure less than half of maximum working pressure until viscosity falls below 54 mm 2 /s.

 

Hydraulic Fluids

-Maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds,etc. Specifications may differ according to the hydraulic fluid used.

 

Mineral Oils

-Please use general industrial use anti-wear fluids.

 

Fire Resistant Fluids

-Water glycols may be used with us standard type pumps. However maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds, etc., specifications will differ from those of mineral oil fluids. Please refer to specifications of each pump for details.

-Fluorine seals are used with pumps that operate on phosphate ester fluids. An "F3-" suffix is used to designate such pumps. However specifications for maximum operating pressures, maximum speeds, etc., will differ from those of mineral oil fluids.

 

Hydraulic Fluid Viscosity and Temperature

-Please operate pump with viscosity level within 13~54 mm 2 /s range. Maximum viscosity allowed is 860 mm2/s (220 mm 2 /s for V20, V30 Series), but warm up and operation should be done in accordance with the paragraph on "Warm Up".

-Fluid temperature should be maintained below 65°C.

Features

The standard hydraulic cylinder of the Y-HG1 metallurgical equipment is a double-acting single piston rod hydraulic rod. The rod diameter is from 40 to 320 mm.
